actor.description: The appraiser handles every piece in view, making quiet substitutions difficult.

object.description: An estate cart mixes keepsakes with ordinary stock; faded wrapping notes show which pieces arrived together.

description_variants.segmented_appraisal_cart: The cart is divided into signed sections, giving every object a visible place in the appraisal.
description_variants.service_lane: The sorted cart waits beside the counter without blocking the customer path.

object.label: Estate Cart

object.description: Faded initials and auction dots offer the only honest trail through the estate lot.

description_variants.left: The clerk stands beside the filed copy, away from the open door.

actor.description: Sal studies the unfinished bench before looking at customers; useful work will get farther than flattery.

description_variants.service_lane: Sal waits behind the counter with the open work lane between you.

description_variants.checking_finished_job: Sal checks the completed repair closely, ready to talk once the work proves itself.
